findings.source_quote: God Would Not Let Me Go
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the title to convey the English meaning (that God would not allow the author to be lost or forsaken). Example: replace the title text with: "Mungu Hakunitupa" or better: "Mungu Hakunitia Mkono" or more literal: "Mungu Hapendi Kuniruhusu Niondoke" — keep it short and natural. Ensure the replacement appears inside the same <title> element.

Translate the section name using an idiomatic Kiswahili heading that preserves the sense of encouragement for young people. For example: "MSUKUMO KWA VIJANA" or "MOTHSHA ZA VIONGOZI KWA VIJANA" (recommended: "MOTISHA KWA VIJANA"). Replace the section string but keep it in the same metadata field.

Translate the Bible book name to conventional Kiswahili usage and keep the chapter and verse numbers unchanged. For example: "(angalia 1 Wakorintho 6:9-11)" or fully in Kiswahili: "(angalia 1 Wakorintho 6:9–11)". Make this substitution in the same paragraph so the parenthetical reference is rendered in Kiswahili but preserves the numeric reference exactly.
